name: autoexec_job
label: Automation Job List
description: The automated job schedule is designed for tracking automated statuses, time dimension statistics, and query associations. It supports reporting scenarios for automated tasks.

fields.name: id
fields.description: ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Job status. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: operation_type
fields.description: Script/tool/flow. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Job source. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: exec_user
fields.description: UUID of the executing user, role, or group.

fields.name: trigger_type
fields.description: Trigger mode (auto: automatically triggered; manual: manually triggered).

fields.name: parent_id
fields.description: When the parent ID is -1, it indicates that the data is a parent job. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_parent_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the parent_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_source
indexes.description: Standard index covering the source field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_status
indexes.description: Standard index covering the status field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_typeid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the operation_type field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
